# NotificationToast

**Class:** `UltraCanvasNotificationToast` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/UltraMessage/UltraCanvasNotificationToast.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/UltraMessage/UltraCanvasNotificationToast.h) · `#include "Plugins/UltraMessage/UltraCanvasNotificationToast.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A notification on screen (a toast: app, summary, body, action buttons, close) - and `UltraCanvasNotificationToastHost`, which draws the UltraMessage notifications nothing else draws, stacked in a screen corner. For the desktop shell only: an application posts a `system.notification` instead ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasNotificationToast.md))

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasNotificationToast> CreateNotificationToast( const std::string& identifier, float x = 0, float y = 0, float w = 340, float h = 0);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasNotificationToast(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onAction` | `std::function<void(const std::string& actionId)> onAction` | "default" for a click on the summary or the body, else the button's action id. |
| `onClose` | `std::function<void()> onClose` | the close button |
| `onHover` | `std::function<void()> onHover` | the pointer came onto it |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
